Saberstaff Combat Styles

Choose Saberstaff for attacks with resource or defensive benefits, or for repeated strikes against nearby enemies.

Saberstaff - Conduit

Conduit attacks gain benefits when both Force and Stamina are above stated thresholds, including a defensive bonus.

Saberstaff - Tempest

Tempest includes multi-hit attacks, nearby-area attacks, and benefits when attacks connect.
